description: Na₂CO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.31 Å) and four longer (2.35 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one C and seven O atoms. The Na-C bond length is 2.98 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.59-2.91 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to five Na and one C atom.
